ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. A transcript reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.transcript-db owns it.

rules.range: A row is what was said in clip frames [from_frame, to_frame) of a clip: its lines and words as clip frames, the language and the engine that heard it.
rules.replace: A range transcribed again replaces the row of the same clip and range; other ranges stay.
